title: Boolean array addition changes with optimization
evidence: For bool a[2] containing true values, add(a,a)[0] evaluates to true at O0 and false at O2. Vulkan execution observed output 1 versus 0; scalar bool addition and bool-array min controls pass. Both shaders validate.
next_step: Define bool arithmetic explicitly, then promote operands or reject unsupported bool operations consistently.

title: Record-valued stage input ABI mismatch
evidence: Vertex/fragment entry inputs passed as records by value abort in llvm::CallInst::init (bad function signature), including a flat integer record.
next_step: Marshal parameters using the Clang ABI, or reject unsupported entry parameter shapes before wrapper generation.

title: Arrays of buffer device addresses
evidence: A push record with __storage__ float *data[2], followed by dereference of its entries, aborts in DataLayout::getTypeSizeInBits on an unsized type at both optimization levels.
next_step: Preserve nested pointer element types through aggregate lowering and inference.

title: Pointer-to-pointer device-address buffers
evidence: Dereferencing __storage__ float * __storage__ *data aborts with the same unsized-type assertion at O0 and O2. This is a separate reproducer, not proof of a separate root cause from F03.
next_step: Handle nested physical pointer types or issue a semantic rejection before backend lowering.

title: Physical-pointer selection at O2
evidence: Choosing between two physical-storage pointer fields with ?: validates at O0 but aborts at O2: byte layout pointer must come from spv.resource.getpointer.
next_step: Preserve physical pointee types and legal byte-layout provenance through optimization and phi/select lowering.

title: Unknown storage image format
cases: storage_format_unknown, storage_unknown_load, storage_format_invalid, storage_format_r32i, storage_format_r32ui, format_type_mismatch_unused
evidence: storage_texture_2d<float, unknown> load or store aborts at both levels (Unable to meet SPIR-V requirements). An out-of-range format reaches spirv-val; float plus integer formats also reach validator rejection. An unused mismatched resource is accepted and removed.
next_step: Check supported format values and component categories in Sema. Implement formatless capabilities deliberately or diagnose unsupported formatless access.

title: Records with multiple device-address fields
evidence: Reading and dereferencing multiple physical pointers from a push record often emits forbidden OpBitcast on logical PushConstant pointers at both levels. Merely adding an integer prefix does not fix it. Some native atomic forms infer types successfully; this is not a claim that every multi-pointer record fails.
next_step: Preserve actual pointee types for each field; avoid logical pointer reinterpretation.

title: Nested records containing device addresses
evidence: A nested record with two pointer fields emits an access-chain index into the outer one-member struct, instead of the nested record, at both levels.
next_step: Retain complete aggregate index paths during scalarization.

severity: High: invalid SPIR-V; previously documented incomplete area
title: Physical pointer null handling
evidence: Comparing a device-address pointer to nullptr, or selecting a nullptr value, emits forbidden OpConstantNull for PhysicalStorageBuffer at both levels.
next_step: Represent physical null addresses and comparisons using legal SPIR-V address conversion/operations.

title: Runtime indexing of vector/matrix intrinsic results
cases: result_bounds, matrix_dynamic, normalize_reference_chain; runtime: dynamic_result_index, dynamic_matrix_index
evidence: Dynamic indexing into the returned result aggregate fails validation at O0: an element index is incorrectly used on its one-member wrapper struct. O2 validates and the numerical probes pass.
next_step: Preserve the wrapper data-array member path for variable indexing.

title: Nested multidimensional push arrays at O2
evidence: Runtime indexing p->a[idx%2][idx%3] validates at O0 but produces an undefined SPIR-V ID at O2.
next_step: Repair optimized aggregate index lowering and ID/type assignment.

title: First-member arrays in nested/over-aligned records
evidence: Dynamic indexing through a nested first-member array fails at both levels. A local alignas(32) record whose first member is an array fails at O0 and passes at O2. Validator reports that a struct index must be a constant.
next_step: Keep zero-offset record members distinct from their contained arrays.

title: Selecting ordinary local pointers at O0
evidence: A ?: choosing &a or &b for local floats fails validation at O0 because variable-pointer capabilities are absent; O2 scalarizes it and passes.
next_step: Scalarize these patterns before emission, provide appropriate supported capabilities, or diagnose the unsupported operation clearly.

title: 8/16-bit interface storage features missing from reflection
cases: push_short, push_unsigned_char, push__Float16, uniform_short, uniform_unsigned_char, uniform__Float16
evidence: Validated modules use actual 8/16-bit push/uniform members. Reflection lists shaderInt8/shaderInt16/shaderFloat16 but omits storagePushConstant8/16 and uniformAndStorageBuffer8/16BitAccess as applicable. Enabling just the reported arithmetic features is insufficient.
next_step: Infer storage feature requirements from interface storage classes and leaf types, and emit matching capabilities as needed.

title: Float-only pointer shaders acquire Int8 capability
evidence: A shader using only a float device-address pointer and float stores nevertheless contains an unused PhysicalStorageBuffer pointer-to-uchar type, OpCapability Int8, and a shaderInt8 reflection requirement. The reflection accurately describes the emitted capability, but that capability is unnecessary for the source program.
next_step: Avoid defaulting physical pointee types to i8 when the actual element type is known, and remove unused types/capabilities.
